what: Dynamic community gate on the harmonized hybrid panel (gapseq-derived Bacteroidetes namespace-translated to BiGG + native BiGG Firmicutes, all ATPM-yield-calibrated, sharing ONE BiGG DM38 pool). 25 monos + 126 pairs.
answers: Does correct yield fix muODE's dynamic competition, or is per-step max-biomass FBA structurally winner-take-all regardless? -> PARTIALLY: fixes WHO wins (direction), only half-fixes HOW MUCH coexistence (magnitude).

headline.pair_winner_0.52_to_0.73_ceiling_0.79: near the yield ceiling; was coin-flip
headline.minority_share_0.06_to_0.13_measured_0.2: coexistence doubled but still ~2x too exclusionary

harmonization.method: boundary translation gapseq->BiGG via embedded bigg.metabolite / metanetx.chemical annotations; internal cpd network untouched
harmonization.invariance_test: 9/9 Bacteroidetes: native ModelSEED biomass == harmonized BiGG biomass, ratio 1.00 -- translation is exact

caveats: Pairwise gate only (monos+126 pairs); full 549-community composition MAE (dynamic) is the next stage, not yet run.

Residual winner-take-all: minority share 0.13 vs measured 0.26 -- the max-biomass LP still over-excludes; a moderated-objective (e.g. pFBA / enzyme-pool / not-quite-max-growth) is the candidate next mechanism.
6 strains still under-grow in both reconstructions (BL,BH,DF,BA,CH,DP).
